correctness.rationale: Published full toric-ideal generating theorem for exactly this coprime repunit family supplies all moves of bounded length a+b+1. Direct coprime divisibility kR_n-LR_n=aE forces E=qR_n; repunit magnitude yields L>=qb+1 and k>=q(a+b)+1; for the critical k=a+b+1, a sharp deficit bound proves the unique second factorization g_2+b g_n. Two disjoint factorizations and no others force c of this element to equal a+b+1. Every quantifier n,b>=2,a>=1 with gcd(a,R_n)=1 is addressed, n=2 separately. The packaged Python verifier passes 118 arithmetic parameter checks and 59 exhaustive critical fibers for 18 triples; this does not substitute for the proof.
